Chapter 879: Chapter 17 Transfer (Please Subscribe)_2

Regarding the current state of being destitute and homeless, this was a first.

“What exactly do the Queens intend, and how should we deal with the Galaxy Master…” Even after the departure of the Galaxy Master, the most powerful of the Insect Race at the Eleventh Layer did not dare to move in the slightest, their minds racing.

…

Elsewhere on the battlefield.

Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, and space-time rippled like the ‘Milky Way’, from which an exquisitely beautiful woman with twenty pairs of wings emerged from the spatial crevice.

“Found you.”

At the mere thought from Lin Yuan, space-time coalesced from all directions.

“Not good.”

Tianyu Meng’s face changed drastically, wearing that divine angelic crown that radiated an incomparably sacred light, piercing through numerous space-times. The powers of the Twelfth Layer converged, breaking free from the spatial bind in a flash and fleeing far away.

“She ran again?”

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

Those peak wielders of the Eleventh Layer holding Clan Suppression Weapons managed to repeatedly escape from his grasp not because of their own strength, but because of the methods left behind within the Clan Suppression Weapons by the Twelfth Layer.

“With my current strength, dealing with the Clan Suppression Weapons of the major peak clans is indeed somewhat strenuous.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself in silence.

His pursuit of those most powerful escapees of the Eleventh Layer was a casual effort; killing a few would be great, and if not, it wasn’t a big deal. At the very least, it clarified the gap between himself and the strongest beings.

“Hmm?”

“Xia Qin, the supreme being, is looking for me?”

At the stir of Lin Yuan’s thought, his true essence on the Milky Way Main Star immediately split a wisp of spiritual will, connecting to the Virtual World, and entering the personal world of Xia Qin, the supreme being.

The grand Evolution Tower.

Xia Qin, the supreme being, sits high on the throne.

Lin Yuan appeared below.

“Greetings, Supreme Being.” Lin Yuan bowed slightly to Xia Qin, the supreme being, as a sign of respect.

“Lin Yuan.” Xia Qin, the supreme being, looked at Lin Yuan with some realization.

When he first summoned Lin Yuan, the latter had just entered the Eighth Layer, an incredibly naive young one.

How much time has passed since then for Lin Yuan to have grown to this extent? Although all supreme beings of the Twelfth Layer believe that Lin Yuan’s method of annihilating tens of thousands of the Eleventh Layer came from external forces.

But to activate those external forces, strength is also needed.

For instance, to refine a supreme weapon, one needs the insights of at least the Fifth Realm of Space-Time; without it, the supreme weapon can’t be activated even if it is right before one’s eyes.

“Supreme Being, I…” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, planning to offer an explanation he’d prepared in advance to Xia Qin, the supreme being.

“No need to tell me.” Xia Qin, the supreme being, waved his hand, indicating that human civilization places great importance on privacy, and supreme beings are no exception, not casually prying into each other’s secrets.

Knowing about Lin Yuan’s fortuitous secrets was sufficient; there was no need to vocalize them.

“Although those alien races of the Eleventh Layer have been almost entirely killed or injured on the battlefield, the war has not ended yet. You need to be even more careful from now on.”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, said with a slightly grave expression.

“The war is not over?” Lin Yuan’s face was serious.

Currently, the eleven peak clan forces still have the most powerful beings of the Eleventh Layer barely clinging to life, so they cannot be said to have been completely annihilated.

Even if these most powerful beings of the Eleventh Layer also die at Lin Yuan’s hands, those peak clan forces can continuously send more of the Eleventh Layer to join the battlefield.

“So many supreme weapons and treasures have fallen into your hands, tsk, the old fellows are probably going to be desperate.”

Xia Qin, the supreme being, snickered coldly, then looked at Lin Yuan and said, “According to the rules of the super-large battlefield, within a hundred years of the war’s start, entry is allowed, but not exit.”

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

This means that even if he acquires a great number of supreme weapons and treasures, as long as within a hundred years, Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit dies on the battlefield.

Then those supreme weapons and treasures will return to the hands of the peak clan forces.

“Right now, we are under the close scrutiny of those old timers, and we cannot help you transfer those supreme weapons and treasures.” Xia Qin, the supreme being, sighed.

So many mighty weapons and treasures made even the strongest like Xia Qin envious. If only they could be moved out of the battlefield, even if one didn’t keep any for oneself, the peak clans would suffer a heavy loss.

Moreover, these mighty weapons and treasures, in the hands of the Galaxy Master, would also enhance and lift the foundation of human civilization.

It’s a pity.

All the peak clans were guarding against the strongest of human civilization taking covert action to move those mighty weapons and treasures out of Lin Yuan’s hands on the battlefield.

Super-large battlefields are inherently capable of isolating the inside from the outside, and entities of the Twelfth Layer, the ultimate beings, cannot directly intervene. What’s more, with many ultimate beings watching, the nine strongest members of human civilization are unlikely to engage in any secret tactics.

“As for those mighty weapons and treasures, don’t be too insistent on them. If you feel you cannot defend them, just give them up,” suggested the strongest, Xia Qin.

…

Super-large battlefield.

Lin Yuan returned to the war base of human civilization.

In the control room, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

“Six hundred and twenty-three mighty weapons.” Inside the world of Lin Yuan’s Consciousness Incarnation, numerous mighty weapons piled up like mountains, their terrifying aura permeating and spreading.

The trip to the Two-dimensional World yielded Lin Yuan just over thirty mighty weapons, but now the number of mighty weapons had surged to over six hundred.

“So many mighty weapons? And you want me to give them up?”

Lin Yuan, of course, was unwilling, as these were precious resources for cultivation. Even if he couldn’t use them himself, he could exchange them for the treasures he desired.

Among the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Skies, mighty weapons were akin to ‘hard currency’, which could be exchanged for any resource.

…

For the strongest beings like Xia Qin and the other eight human civilization’s ultimate beings, they couldn’t think of any way to help Lin Yuan silently transfer this batch of mighty weapons and treasures.

The ultimate entities of the Twelfth Layer from other peak clans also didn’t believe that human civilization had the capability to transfer them.

The super-large battlefield was right under their eyes, and if the nine strongest members of human civilization interfered at all, they would immediately be discovered by all the ultimate beings.

And without relying on the strongest of human civilization, merely relying on a life from the river of time like the Galaxy Master, there was even less possibility to transfer them.

Super-large battlefields are isolated from the outside spacetime, and unless at specific times, life inside cannot get out at all.

Even the strongest inside a super-large battlefield, if they tried to leave using their powerful abilities, would cause violent spacetime fluctuations, which would then be detected by all the ultimate entities.

But what the Twelfth Layer ultimate entities couldn’t do doesn’t mean Lin Yuan couldn’t.

The war base of human civilization, inside the control room.

With a slight movement of Lin Yuan’s thoughts, a separate incarnation was created.

This incarnation carried a thread of his mental presence, able to exhibit strength from the Third to the Fourth Layer of the Eleventh Realm.

Lin Yuan looked at the incarnation before him, pondered for a moment, then took out a spatial bracelet.

Within the spatial bracelet were over six hundred mighty weapons, along with many precious treasures.

In any case, all the gains from this trip in the super-large battlefield were stored inside Lin Yuan’s spatial bracelet.

Swoosh.

The spatial bracelet rose into the air, hovering in front of the incarnation, lightly grasped by it.

Eventually, the incarnation nodded slightly towards Lin Yuan, its figure slowly disappearing, vanishing before Lin Yuan, disappearing within the super-large battlefield.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan’s incarnation appeared out of nowhere.

“Hahaha, indeed, even within a super-large battlefield, it’s easy to enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Even the ultimate beings of the Twelfth Layer, if they wanted to leave the super-large battlefield, would cause severe spacetime fluctuations. But Lin Yuan, as the master of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,

merely had to think it, and with the Xuanhuang Seal, he could descend from any location in the universe into the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Although the spacetime was isolated in the super-large battlefield, it still belonged within the universe. Lin Yuan could likewise easily descend.

And in the process of leaving the super-large battlefield, it didn’t raise any ripples or disturbances. The Xuanhuang Secret Realm was opened by Xuanhuang himself.

And Xuanhuang, a Chaos Realm powerhouse with an understanding of the Ninth Realm of spacetime, was far beyond the imagination of the Twelfth Layer ultimate entities of various peak clans in the field of spacetime.
